messages:
jess: Heads-up — TeraQuell dedicated cutover scheduled for tomorrow 23:00 UTC. Posting the preflight here, please ack your section. TL;DR: service account perms, KMS, runtime pin, rollback criteria.

samir: Which runtime are we pinning to? last-minute kernel changes in the newer builds could affect latency.

kai: Recommend pin to `runtime-1.14.2-rt` (verified on staging). `runtime-1.15.x` introduced a batching kernel change that regressed p95 in some long-seq workloads.

diane: Confirmed with infra: TeraQuell service account needs kms:Decrypt on `projects/teraq-ops/keys/teraq-main` + secretmanager access to read tenant certs. I requested the role binding, waiting on cloud team.

olivia: Release notes drafted, attaching snippet. Main callouts: model variant v2 -> v2a (quantized), KV cache priming, new rollout timeout semantics. Need an explicit note about cache warm-up in the customer-facing doc.

samir: Rollback criteria proposal: auto-rollback if p95 latency > 600ms for 10m continuous OR error-rate > 2% for 5m. Manual rollback if synthetic QA fails > 3 endpoints. Thoughts?

jess: Agree with those thresholds. Add one more: if throughput drops > 30% vs baseline for 15m, trigger a pause and investigation (not automatic rollback).

olivia: Added to notes. Also set canary window to 30m with a 3-slice stagger.

deploybot: deploy intent registered by @jess for `teraquell-dedicated`
deploybot: canary slices: slice-a -> slice-b -> slice-c (30m windows). planned start: 2024-08-17T23:00:00Z. rollback policy: auto + manual as discussed.

samir: Quick sanity check on the KV cache priming: we should preload prefixes for their top-50 prompt templates. I can run a priming job during the 1h quiet window.

diane: Cloud team granted the SA perms — IAM binding applied @ 2024-08-17T14:12Z. Please verify in your preflight checks.

kai: Confirming runtime pin: I've pushed a pin in the deployment manifest: `runtime: runtime-1.14.2-rt` and set fallback to `runtime-1.13.9-rt` in case of regression.

jess: Nice. Can someone paste the IAM snippet we're using so support can cross-check?

samir: Sure — snippet below for the SA role we applied:
```
resource: projects/teraq-ops/serviceAccounts/tera-service@teraq-ops.iam.gserviceaccount.com
bindings:
  - role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
    members: [
      serviceAccount:tera-service@teraq-ops.iam.gserviceaccount.com
    ]
  - role: roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor
    members: [
      serviceAccount:tera-service@teraq-ops.iam.gserviceaccount.com
    ]
```

olivia: Thanks. I've added the note to the customer-facing rollout doc and pinged CS to schedule the brief (10m) runbook walk-through during the quiet window.

deploybot: canary slice `slice-a` scheduled (ETA 2024-08-17T23:00:00Z). preflight checks: IAM OK, runtime pinned, release notes linked, priming job scheduled.

diane: One item: their KMS rotation is due two days after our cutover window. We asked them to delay until +72h to avoid key rewrap during initial traffic. They agreed.

samir: Priming job queued — will start at T-30m to the cutover (so priming ends just before slice-a opens).

jess: Final asks: @olivia confirm CS brief done, @kai stand by for rapid rollback ops, @samir monitor priming. If everyone ok I will mark go/no-go at T-10m.

olivia: CS brief scheduled for T-15m. I'll drop the join link in this thread. :white_check_mark:

kai: Standby and on-call pager configured. :rotating_light:

samir: Monitoring dashboards pinned, alerts set for the three thresholds.

jess: Great — I'm marking this thread as preflight-complete. See you all in the quiet window. :thumbsup:

deploybot: deploy request accepted, will post step updates to this thread during rollout.
